scope: Additive Locked product decision from owner: all coffee URL preview paths; retain all original Master Specification and Decision Ledger decisions.

decisions.decision: Enforce at least 30 seconds between all roaster URL preview/metadata lookup requests from the same admitted member account, whether the roaster is already trusted or previously unknown. The quota must be account-wide across preview paths, not separately bypassable by known/unknown domain fallbacks. A member can still manually add a coffee and log shots during cooldown.

implementation_notes: 60 lookups per rolling 24-hour window is a reversible anti-abuse engineering default, NOT a Locked product requirement. User explicitly authorized publishing this release without asking for another Netlify credit verification; do not fictionalize billing evidence or change canonical cost-control policies. URL/screenshot first, optional device-local Claude BYOK, community Verified provenance and Pending personal use remain unchanged.
